description: This file contains implementation of big number multiplication and squaring functions, including recursive and optimized algorithms for cryptographic operations in the BIGNUM library, specifically for the BoringSSL project.

methods.name: bn_abs_sub_words
methods.description: Performs absolute subtraction of two word arrays with sign handling.

methods.name: bn_mul_normal
methods.description: Performs normal multiplication of two big number arrays.

methods.name: bn_sub_part_words
methods.description: Subtracts parts of big number arrays with length and delta parameters.

methods.name: bn_abs_sub_part_words
methods.description: Performs absolute subtraction of parts of big number arrays, returning sign mask.

methods.name: bn_mul_recursive
methods.description: Implements recursive Karatsuba multiplication for large big numbers.

methods.name: bn_mul_part_recursive
methods.description: Performs recursive multiplication on parts of big numbers with size constraints.

methods.name: bn_sqr_normal
methods.description: Performs normal squaring of big number arrays.

methods.name: bn_sqr_recursive
methods.description: Implements recursive squaring for large big numbers.

methods.name: BN_mul
methods.description: Public API for multiplying two BIGNUMs.

methods.name: bn_mul_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation of BIGNUM multiplication supporting different algorithms.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba4

methods.name: bn_mul_comba8
methods.description: Optimized multiplication for 8-word big numbers (not shown in code).

methods.name: BN_sqr
methods.description: Public API for squaring a BIGNUM.

methods.name: bn_sqr_consttime
methods.description: Internal implementation of BIGNUM squaring with constant-time support.

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba4
methods.description: Optimized squaring for 4-word big numbers (not shown in code).

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba8

methods.name: bn_mul_small

methods.description: Squares small arrays of words representing big numbers.
